title: Popper
description: Low-level positioned layer anchored to an element, used to build menus, dropdowns and popovers. Near the viewport edges it flips to the opposite side and shifts to stay visible, and it follows the anchor on scroll and resize.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Popper is controlled: pass anchorEl and visible, update visibility in onVisibleChange and close with onClickAway. Escape also requests closing and returns focus to the anchor.

placements.title: Placements
placements.description: Twelve placements around the anchor; near the viewport edges the popper flips and shifts. With trigger="manual" you decide when it opens.

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.description: Click, hover, focus or right-click on the anchor requests a visibility change.

variants.title: Variants and arrow
variants.description: Color variants with an arrow pointing at the anchor.

menu.title: Menu
menu.description: type="menu" gives the popper role="menu" for lists of actions.

sizes.title: Sizes and scrolling
sizes.description: Preset sizes with fixed dimensions; long content wraps with multiline and scrolls with scrollable.

custom-style.title: Custom style
custom-style.description: Customize colors, dimensions, offset (here a 12px gap to the right of the anchor), transition and z-index.

anchor-width.title: Match anchor width
anchor-width.description: matchAnchorWidth="exact" makes the popper exactly as wide as its anchor ("min" makes it at least as wide), and role overrides the default ARIA role, here listbox.

PopperProps.anchorEl: Element the popper is positioned against
PopperProps.type: Functional type; sets the default role ("menu" for menu, "tooltip" for tooltip, otherwise "dialog")
PopperProps.offset: Offset in pixels. For top/bottom placements y is the gap to the anchor and x shifts along it; for left/right placements x is the gap and y shifts along it. Without it the popper sits 8px away from the anchor
PopperProps.arrow: Shows an arrow pointing at the anchor
PopperProps.onClickAway: Called on mousedown outside both the popper and the anchor
PopperProps.multiline: Allows text to wrap onto multiple lines
PopperProps.trigger: Anchor interaction that requests a visibility change via onVisibleChange
PopperProps.onVisibleChange: Called with the requested visibility when the trigger fires
PopperProps.scrollable: Lets the content scroll when it overflows
PopperProps.width: Fixed width, overriding the size preset
PopperProps.height: Fixed height, overriding the size preset
PopperProps.ref: Ref to the popper element (rendered in a portal on document.body)
PopperProps.id: id of the popper element, e.g. for the anchor's aria-controls
PopperProps.flip: Flips to the opposite side when the preferred placement would overflow the viewport
PopperProps.shift: Shifts along the anchor to stay inside the viewport
PopperProps.matchAnchorWidth: Sizes the popper after the anchor: "min" makes it at least as wide as the anchor, "exact" exactly as wide
PopperProps.closeOnEscape: Requests closing (onVisibleChange(false)) when Escape is pressed inside the popper or on the anchor; focus inside the popper returns to the anchor
PopperProps.role: ARIA role of the popper element; defaults to "menu" for type="menu", "tooltip" for type="tooltip" and "dialog" otherwise

PopperOffset.x: Horizontal offset in pixels: the gap for left/right placements, the shift along the anchor for top/bottom placements
PopperOffset.y: Vertical offset in pixels: the gap for top/bottom placements, the shift along the anchor for left/right placements
